title: The self-model can in principle be identified with brain processes

statements.text: The theory explicitly endorses a possible reductive identification of phenomenal self-models in the human brain, and it is close to predictive processing accounts of brain function. As a representationalist account, it holds that what is consciously experienced is the representational content of a state realized by a physical carrier.
